How we track results

Final statistics exclude provisional results and pending picks. Win rate is wins ÷ (wins + losses); pushes are excluded. Profit estimates use your standard bet amount from Settings (default $100) per selection, and same-game sportsbook pricing may differ.

Better than the final price answers a simple question: did we get a better deal than someone who waited until just before kickoff? About 20 minutes before each game, we record the best price any sportsbook still offers on the same bet. If the price we posted pays more, the pick counts as better than the final price. For parlays, we compare the whole parlay, and only when every leg has a final price. Beating the final price again and again is one of the clearest signs of real skill, and it shows up much sooner than a win–loss record does.

Provisional results use reported stats. Final box score not confirmed means the result can still change. Confirmation requires final game stats and an unchanged repeat check at least five minutes later.

One losing leg establishes a parlay loss even if other games have not finished. A parlay win needs every leg graded as a win or push. Missing stats never count as zero, and a missing player row does not establish non-participation or a void.

Only snapshots verified against pregame provider offers appear here. Historical replays, unverified older submissions and personal slips are excluded. Picks before the Sept. 24–28 slate were pre-season test picks from an earlier version of the site. They are kept in the history for transparency, labeled separately, and are not part of the official record. Official picks are selected centrally and kept separate from personal slips.

Weekly caps: 100 individual props, 15 conservative parlays, 10 mid-range parlays and 5 long shot parlays. These are ceilings, not quotas. Official picks require fresh, two-sided prices from at least three books and at least a one-percentage-point price edge. Picks publish during the 24 hours before kickoff as the board refreshes; publication closes five minutes before kickoff. Original odds and selections are never replaced by a refresh.

To reduce overlap, official singles use one market per player/game and at most eight picks per game. Official parlays use different games, share at most one player/game with another official parlay, and use any player/game at most three times across the weekly parlay record. Weeks run Tuesday noon UTC to Tuesday noon UTC, keeping Monday-night games together.

Results show the latest 500 verified selections. Odds: The Odds API. Player stats: BALLDONTLIE. Some markets need play-by-play verification; later stat corrections may require review.
